mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.15% signals aggressive monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.15.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 900 thousand units indicate robust consumer confidence in durable goods, triggering positive equity returns as housing demand correlates with broader consumption growth over 20 days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 900 coincides with negative 20-day S&P 500 returns in >60% of cases, or correlation between HOUST and SPX returns drops below 0.15.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and stable CPIAUCSL (within ±0.25 index points) indicates accommodative policy without inflation risk, producing positive equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint signal occurs but 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances, or interaction effect size (beta) is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 5.0% signals tight labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 5.0 coincides with negative 5-day S&P 500 returns in >60% of cases, or correlation between UNRATE and SPX returns is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 98.0) indicates strengthening manufacturing output, reducing equity risk premiums and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 98.0 occurs but 60-day returns are negative in >60% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL rising above 231.5 index points signals accelerating inflation, prompting central bank rate hikes that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 231.5 coincides with positive 60-day returns in >60% of instances, or inflation signal fails to correlate with negative returns (correlation < -0.15).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in housing starts (HOUST > 900) and payroll employment (PAYEMS > 134,000) indicates synchronized consumer and labor market strength, driving positive equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint signal occurs but 20-day returns are negative in >60% of cases, or interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Post-GFC recovery phase (defined by GDP growth > 2.5% annualized) combined with rising residential construction (HOUST > 900) generates sustained equity momentum over 20 days.
failure_condition: Regime condition met but 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances, or GDP growth signal fails to correlate with positive returns (correlation < 0.20).
